# notion - Brand Design Reference

This directory contains design system analysis for notion.

## Contents

- DESIGN.md - Full brand design tokens (color palette, typography, spacing)
- README.md - Source attribution

## Usage

Read the YAML frontmatter in DESIGN.md for design tokens:

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| colors | Semantic color palette (primary, ink, canvas, surface) |
| 	ypography | Type scale (fontFamily, fontSize, fontWeight, lineHeight, letterSpacing) |
